phase5CropSense.heroTitle: Choose the next crop with your soil context
phase5CropSense.heroDescription: Review your latest soil values, rainfall, season, water availability, location and farm size before comparing crops. The current suitability score uses the AGRIVA rule set described below.
phase5CropSense.engineDescription: Current CropSense scoring uses pH, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, seasonal rainfall, season and water availability. Organic carbon, moisture, temperature, location and farm size are collected as context but are not part of the current match formula. This is rule-based decision support, not a trained AI model.
